EXPLANATION OF SYMBOLS

The Chapter and delegation of each member are indicated both in the Geographical
Section and in the Alphabetical Section by letters and numerals following the member's
name. If a member has been affiliated with more than one Chapter, all are shown.

Chapter names are represented by the following symbols:

Theta Th Xi X Mu M
Delta D Upsilon U Rho R
Beta B Iota I Epsilon Ep
Sigma S Fhi Ph Om.icron Om
Gamma G Omega O Delta Delta DD
Zeta Z Pi P Theta Theta TT
Lambda L Chi c Nu N

Kappa K Beta Beta BB Epsilon Phi EpP
Psi Ps Eta E Zeta Zeta ZZ
Tau T

The number appearing at the extreme right of each line in the Alphabetical Section is
that of the column of the Geographical Section in which the address of that member
appears. The letters "AU" indicate Address Unknown.
